task_description: Issue #311 (eliasrosa/kirocrew-flow): support squads_dir (a directory of squad yamls) in deployment.config with squad_config kept as fallback; document Azure DevOps as SCM-only (issue providers are github|jira) in squads/example.yaml; document the dev onboarding flow. Plus the issue-comment requirement: per-repo issue_provider override (RepoConfig.issue_provider, _parse_squad parsing, SquadConfig.issue_provider_for(repo), and engine wiring in _single_flow_tick/_LedgerStateReader/_LedgerDispatcher to use squad.issue_provider_for(repo)).
